source_files.name: student-problem-middle.json
source_files.format: JSON array of learner sequence objects; attempt records are in each object's seq array

source_files.name: problem.json
source_files.format: JSON Lines: one problem metadata object per line

normalization: Parse the complete selected middle JSON array. Flatten every seq record in the published sequence/record order. No population, correctness, activity, date or outcome filtering and no deduplication are applied.
Write the event frame as events.parquet. Parse problem.json with JSON-Lines semantics and write problems.parquet.
Join course_id from the problem catalog by problem_id with a validated many-to-one relationship. Retain exercise_id from each event record. All source event rows have catalog matches.
Parse submit_time without inventing a timezone. Sort ascending by timestamp and unique log_id, reset the row index and assign zero-based int64 eid.
Project eid,user_id,course_id,exercise_id,ts,is_correct into history.parquet. All 898933 records are retained; all observed timestamps fall in 2020.

serving_snapshot_rules.population: At least 10 observed window attempts per user-course participation and at least 6 distinct course exercise blocks known before cut; no requirement on future outcomes.
serving_snapshot_rules.classification_query: Most frequent prior-window exercise block, ties broken by ascending block index
serving_snapshot_rules.changed_input: Delete only served-window records with eid modulo 100 equal to zero; preserve query identities, participants and candidate catalog. Recompute shared course-catalog counts from the complete prior history with those records removed.

maintenance_workload_rules.target: First observed attempt in the next seven days on a block known before cut, for the same at-least-10-attempt, at-least-6-block eligibility rule
maintenance_workload_rules.purpose: Fixed retrospective query workloads used to check correction-response algorithms; distinct from the past-only serving populations
maintenance_workload_rules.journal_selection: Independent rng.random over chronologically sorted eligible-window rows, probability 0.05
maintenance_workload_rules.journal_new_values: Subsequent rng.integers(0,2,n_selected); no-op replacements are retained

history_semantic_serialization: UTF-8 compact JSON arrays [eid,user_id,course_id,exercise_id,unix_timestamp_ns,is_correct], LF after each row, sorted by eid
redistribution: Obtain raw files from the authors under their applicable terms. This manifest and preparation code do not grant a new data license.
